commands.command: cd /Users/kangkukjin/Desktop/AI/indiebizOS/outputs/long_sentence_imagination/2026-10-28_101회차; ls -la --time-style=full-iso inputs/A ai_out/A 2>/dev/null || ls -lT inputs/A ai_out/A; wc -l inputs/A/*.md; grep -n "오프라인\|offline\|로컬 AI\|로컬에서\|단절\|격리\|다른 회원\|타 회원\|섞이\|공유 경로\|OS 계정\|OS 사용자" inputs/A/D*.md | cut -c1-200

commands.command: B=/Users/kangkukjin/Desktop/AI/indiebizOS/outputs/long_sentence_imagination/2026-10-28_101회차/inputs/B; R1=$(ls $B/R1_*.md); for r in 27 93 98 116 123 293 298 330 369 487 489; do printf "R1 L%s: " $r; sed -n "${r}p" "$R1" | cut -c1-80; done; for r in 62 65 118; do printf "R2 L%s: " $r; sed -n "${r}p" $B/R2_*.md | cut -c1-80; done; for r in 11 33 41 44; do printf "R3 L%s: " $r; sed -n "${r}p" $B/R3_*.md | cut -c1-80; done
